description:
Metadata Lock Contention — WARN0305

Requires the MariaDB METADATA_LOCK_INFO plugin. Fires when:
- Any single MDL wait >= lock-wait-ms-threshold ms (default 5000ms), or
- Total concurrent MDL waits >= lock-count-threshold (default 3)

config_keys.label: Lock wait threshold (ms)
config_keys.help: Any single metadata lock wait longer than this value fires. MDL waits block all concurrent DML on the affected table.

config_keys.label: Concurrent lock wait threshold
config_keys.help: If no single wait exceeds the duration threshold but total concurrent MDL waits exceed this count, fires.
